column1: # Integration route counters for XML (Apache Camel's XML DSL in Spring or Blueprint, Spring
# Integration, Mule 3 and 4, WSO2 Synapse): the counters of xml-facts, its [ignore] line included,
# then one per route element, with or without a namespace prefix. "producer endpoints" counts to,
# toD, wireTap, enrich and pollEnrich; "Synapse ... (named)" only an element that has a name
# attribute, so a reference to an endpoint does not count as one; "property placeholders" every
# {{name}} and ${name} occurrence, with or without a default, but not a ${...} of Camel's Simple
# language, which reads the message rather than a property: the roots no property file names
# ${variable.x}, ...) in any form, and the roots that are ordinary property names too (in, out, env,
# date, file, bean, ref, type) only in their Simple form: ${in.body}, ${out.header.x}, ${env.HOME} or
# ${type:x}. So Mule's ${env}, ${file.workingDir} and Spring Integration's ${out.dir} or
# ${random.int} count as well, being property names elsewhere. EnterpriseXmlFactPatternsTest pins every case;
# ProfileFactPatternsLinearityTest measures that every pattern reads linearly.
Synapse proxies, APIs, sequences and endpoints (named)
